exactToolArguments.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: DJ-CF-02 instructor renovation example, one photorealistic 1536x1024 landscape image.
INPUT 1 is the original existing PHOTO and exact edit target. INPUT 2 is the elevation geometry check only. Preserve input1 camera, composition, building outline and every opening edge exactly. Output same view as input1, NOT a new angle. Same overcast daytime. Keep every neighboring building, sidewalk/curb and road location unchanged.
MANDATORY: same two-storey 10m-wide 7.2m-high box; same roof and floor lines. Exactly two broad ground windows at left with solid sill walls, one existing single entrance D1 at far right, exactly three upper windows. Five windows and one door total; preserve sizes, positions and central mullions. Keep the long SZ1 sign zone in original x.8..9.2 z3..3.5 area entirely blank. Do not turn wall joints into new openings. Do not change the door glazing/frame. Do not change the image crop or perspective. No text, numbers, logos, people or cars.
Only nonstructural finish/lighting concept changes specified below. No extension, new opening, balcony, roof addition, removed structure, planters in the public sidewalk. This is an educational concept, not a construction or code-compliance drawing.
DESIGN STRATEGY A: FOCUSED ENTRY MARKER.
Express the brief's priority of immediately recognizing the shared entrance. Add a slender bronze-toned metal SURFACE portal closely surrounding D1: thin flat strips on the existing wall left and right of the door, ending below the sign zone, and a compact shallow matching canopy directly above D1 at roughly z2.75. Canopy width about1.9m, modest projection about0.45m, no columns. These are visual design proposals, not confirmed structural dimensions. A faint warm light under the small canopy. Preserve original door rectangle, do not conceal or expand it. Do not let portal cover SZ1 or W5. Make all remaining facade softly neutral light grey mineral plaster; keep SZ1 an understated empty matte grey strip. Only local doorway receives emphasis, rest restrained and comparable with neighbor context. No brick plinth, no broad facade cladding frames. Show convincing thin material finish and modest details, not a sculptural pavilion. Use subtle warm light still in overcast DAYLIGHT, no sunset. Keep all original geometry and surroundings.
